panels.visual: Long before the temples: an old palace on top of the Acropolis rock; old King Aegeus (white beard, crown) on its steps
panels.caption: Long before the temples, a palace stood on this rock. Old King Aegeus lived there.

panels.visual: Medea (long black hair, emerald dress and cloak, a soft green glow round her hands) arriving at the palace
panels.caption: His new wife was Medea, a sorceress on the run from Corinth, where she had killed her own children.

panels.visual: Medea holding a little boy and gazing greedily at the throne
panels.caption: Now she had a little son with Aegeus, and she wanted him to be king.

panels.visual: Years earlier, far away: Aegeus hiding a sword and a pair of sandals under a huge rock
panels.caption: But years before, far away, Aegeus had a secret son. He hid a sword and sandals under a huge rock for him.

panels.visual: A sixteen-year-old Theseus (curly hair) heaving the huge rock up and finding the sword and sandals
panels.caption: That son was Theseus. At sixteen he lifted the rock.

panels.visual: Theseus on the road to Athens beating a bandit who has a giant bed
panels.caption: He walked to Athens, beating every bandit on the road.

panels.visual: Theseus arriving at the palace to cheers; Aegeus suspicious; Medea whispering in the king's ear
panels.caption: He arrived famous, but told no one who his father was. Medea whispered: he has come for your throne.

panels.visual: Medea pouring green poison into a golden cup and handing it to the frightened old king
panels.caption: She mixed a cup of poison. Frightened, the old king agreed.

panels.visual: At a feast, Theseus drawing his sword to cut his meat, the hilt clearly visible
panels.caption: At the feast, Theseus drew his sword to cut his meat, so his father would see it.

panels.visual: Aegeus recognising the sword and knocking the poisoned cup flying, green poison hissing on the floor
panels.caption: Aegeus knew that sword.

panels.visual: Medea grabbing her little boy and fleeing in a chariot pulled by two winged dragons
panels.caption: Medea snatched her little boy and fled from Athens.

panels.visual: Aegeus hugging Theseus; Glauka the owl pointing towards the edge of the rock and the sea beyond
panels.caption: Father and son at last. You'll meet this old king again, on the edge of this rock, watching for sails.
